population.lexMeaning: no one/nothing (masculine: no one; neuter: nothing)
population.derivation: Phase 4ap exception_tokens G3762 neuter/feminine forms (95件). G3762 masculine forms 119件は別途処理。

analysis_basis.neuter_rule: Greek neuter gender (A-*SN-N) encodes semantic category "things/matters/actions" — not persons. 何も〜ない (nothing) is structurally correct. Applied to all 85 neuter tokens.
analysis_basis.feminine_rule: All 10 feminine (A-*SF-N) tokens individually audited. Decision: (a) what noun/referent is modified, (b) person or thing?
